sources.snippet: Fast, multi-backend tensor & ML for Rust — CPU · CUDA · Metal · ROCm · Vulkan, with quantization built in. Hanzo ML is a lightweight, memory-safe machine-learning framework for Rust, tuned for performance and built for real deployment — the compute core beneath Hanzo inference. Rebuilt for the Hanzo stack with optimizations for Edge AI, quantization, multimodal workloads, and NVIDIA ...
